appDescription.message: Shows YouTube Music as Discord Rich Presence. Requires the free YTMPresence companion app for Windows.

trackNoneHint.message: Open YouTube Music or reload the existing tab and start a track.

privacyNote.message: YTMPresence stores the token and URL locally in the browser. Playback data is only sent to the local companion on your machine.

msgStatusLoadFailed.message: Status unavailable. Reload the extension and reopen options.

msgTestFailed.message: Check failed. Reopen options and check the connection.

msgSaved.message: Saved. Reload the YouTube Music tab if it was already open.

msgSettingsLoadFailed.message: Settings unavailable. Reload the extension and reopen options.

errTokenMissingInput.message: Token missing. Copy it from the tray menu and paste it here.

errInvalidUrl.message: Invalid companion URL. Allowed hosts are localhost or 127.0.0.1.

testNoResponse.message: No response from the companion. Is the tray app running and the URL correct?

testWsCreateFailed.message: Could not create WebSocket. Check the companion URL.

testNotRecognized.message: The companion did not recognize the connection test.

testOk.message: Companion connection confirmed. Check the presence in Discord.

testBadToken.message: Token rejected. Copy the current token from the companion, then save and check in options.

testUnreachable.message: Companion not reachable. Start the tray app or check the URL.

testClosedEarly.message: The connection closed before the test was answered.

bgCommandRejected.message: The YouTube Music tab did not accept the command.

msgSaveFailed.message: Not saved. Reopen settings and try saving again.

msgSavedConnected.message: Saved – companion connected. Open YouTube Music or reload the existing tab.

msgSavedRejected.message: Saved – token rejected. Copy the current token from the companion, then save and check again.

msgSavedUnreachable.message: Saved – companion not reachable. Start the companion and try again; if needed, check the URL under Advanced settings.

msgSavedChanged.message: Saved – settings have since changed. Check the current settings again.

msgConfigChanged.message: Settings changed. Check the current settings again.

defaultUrlHint.message: Usually no change is needed. Leave blank for ws://127.0.0.1:17373/ws (with localhost as a fallback).

optionsSetupHint.message: Start the companion, copy its token and paste it here. Then choose “Save and check”.

installationScopeHint.message: Each browser profile and each store or local installation has its own settings. Enable only one YTMPresence extension per profile. Reload existing YouTube Music tabs after switching extensions.

hintTokenMissing.message: Copy the token in the companion, then save and check in options.

hintConnecting.message: Connecting. Keep the companion running; the check takes up to four seconds.

hintAuthenticating.message: The companion is checking the saved token. Please wait.

hintConnected.message: Companion connection confirmed. Check the visible presence in Discord.

hintNoTrack.message: Companion connected, no track data yet. Open YouTube Music or reload the existing tab and start a track.

hintRejected.message: Token rejected. Copy the current token in the companion, then save and check in options.

hintDisconnected.message: Connection interrupted. Start the companion and check again. If needed, check the URL under Advanced settings.

msgSavingTesting.message: Saving settings and checking the connection…

msgUnsaved.message: Unsaved changes. The status describes the saved connection. Choose “Save and check” to apply these inputs.

msgSaveResultUnknown.message: No save result received. Reopen options, review the settings, then save and check again.
